picks.title: Traverse City expands holiday festivities to two-day celebration
picks.desc: Traverse City is expanding its annual downtown holiday festivities into a two-day celebration this year, separating the traditional Christmas tree lighting and light parade across Friday and Saturday. The Traverse City Downtown Development Authority restructured the schedule following public feedback and discussions with the Traverse City Police Department to better manage crowds and improve safety downtown. Under the previous schedule, both marquee attractions were held consecutively on a single Saturday evening. The revised format dedicates Friday evening to the tree lighting and community activities, while the lighted street procession takes center stage the following night.

more.desc: MECOSTA COUNTY - A 40-year-old Rockford man was hospitalized Wednesday after accidentally shooting himself in the foot when his firearm discharged while he was hunting in Mecosta Township, according to the Mecosta County Sheriff’s Office. Deputies were called to a township residence around 6:13 p.m. for a report of a hunter who had been shot. They arrived to find the man suffering from a single gunshot wound. An initial investigation determined the shooting was accidental, and no foul play is suspected. Authorities said the man was hunting on a neighboring property when he tripped, causing his firearm to discharge and strike his foot. He administered first aid by applying a makeshift tourniquet before calling 911 for help.
